# infection by Region and sex
```{r}
by_sex <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(health_officer_region, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    total_pop = sum(total_cnty_pop, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_infected = sum(cumulative_infected, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_infected = total_infected / total_pop,
    rate_100k = round((prop_infected * 1e5),1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


tot_by_sex <- by_sex %>%
  group_by(health_officer_region) %>%
  summarise(
    sex = "BOTH",
    total_pop = sum(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_infected = sum(total_infected, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_infected = total_infected/total_pop,
    rate_100k = round(prop_infected * 1e5,1),
    .groups = "drop")

 

by_sex_tbl <- by_sex %>%
  filter(sex %in% c("FEMALE", "MALE")) %>% 
  bind_rows(tot_by_sex) %>% 
  arrange(health_officer_region,
          factor(sex, levels = c("FEMALE", "MALE", "BOTH")))

sex_tbl <- by_sex_tbl %>% 
  arrange(health_officer_region, sex) %>% 
  mutate(
    Region = ifelse(duplicated(health_officer_region), "", health_officer_region),
    sex = paste0(" ", sex))

sex_tbl %>% 
  select(
    Region,
    sex,
    Total_Population = total_pop,
    Total_Infected = total_infected,
    Proportion_Infecteed = prop_infected,
    Infection_Rate_100K = rate_100k) %>% 
  
kbl(
    escape = FALSE, 
    align = "c",
    col.names = 
      c("Health Officer Region", "", "Total Population", 
        "Total Infected", "Proportion Infected", 
        "Infection Rate per 100K")
) %>%
row_spec(0, 
       bold = TRUE, 
       background = "#0f172a",
       extra_css = "font-size: 16px!important;color:#ffffff;"
) %>%
  
column_spec(6, 
       bold = TRUE, 
       background = "#5ce1e6"
) %>%  
kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("bordered"))

```
